products.name: DeLaurenti House-made Lasagna
products.tagline: Made with care in the DeLaurenti kitchen!
products.description:
Lets face it...the only lasagna that is truly enjoyable to eat is the lasagna you make yourself. It's not complicated, but it takes time. Most of the time, time you do not have. We're here to help. Rather than picking up a box of Stoeffer's at the store by your house, you can now enjoy a lasagna made with care in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. House-made sauce, fresh pasta, the best ricotta, and with the option of meat or veg. The only thing you need to do is set aside an hour to bake it!

serves 2 to 4, 6x6x2.5, apx 3#

products.name: Tirrena Caserecce, 500g
products.tagline: Made with 100% Tuscan Wheat!
products.description:
The Frescobaldi family has embodied the traditions of Tuscan culture, wine & olive oil for well over 1000 years. This pasta is crafted exclusively on the Frescobaldi Estates and comes from the best terroir for growing ancient grains. Cool soils, a mild climate and breezes from the Tyrrhenian Sea give the finished product it's unique character.

Tirrena is a semi-whole durum wheat semolina pasta. Therefore, it is rich in fibers, polyphenols and vitamins. This guarantees its superior nutritional qualities and high digestibility. Bronze drawn and dried for over 72 hours, the pasta has a distinctive hazelnut color and an extraordinary ability to absorb flavor.

products.tagline: Made with organic Umbrian wheat & certified Aqua di Piemonte mountain water!

products.name: DeLaurenti Spinach & Cheese Ravioli, 8oz
products.description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh chopped spinach, fresh ricotta, Parmigiano Reggiano and pecorino romano, with a hint of nutmeg and spices. Wrapped with fresh spinach on one side, and egg pasta on the other, it is perfect with a light red sauce.

products.name: Sfoglini Bigoli, 1lb
products.description:
Bigger and better than Spaghetti, Bigoli originated in the Veneto region of Italy around the early 1600’s when Bartolomio Veronese, aka Abbondanza ("Abundance"), patented the first press for making Bigoli. Bigoli is thicker than spaghetti, providing more rough surface area for holding sauce. This makes Bigoli a popular option for rich meat sauces with wild game ragù and according to tradition, is often eaten - in salsa - with onions, fish and seasoned breadcrumbs.

This pasta was crafted using a bronze die extrusion process that creates a rougher surface for the sauce to cling to. It’s made with premium organic semolina flour, milled from the heart of durum wheat. This type of flour has been a staple in traditional Italian pasta for centuries and helps to create pasta that holds its shape and delivers the perfect al dente bite.

products.name: Sfoglini Cascatelli, 1lb
products.description: Three-time James Beard Award winner Dan Pashman, creator and host of The Sporkful food podcast, presents Cascatelli. Translating to "waterfalls" in Italian, Cascatelli features wavy ruffles along a curved, half-tube shape. ach feature of Cascatelli was thoughtfully designed to bring about these perfect pasta qualities. For example, the ruffles and half-tube shape capture more sauce in every bite, and the variations in textures create a more exciting sensory experience. Additionally, Cascatelli is made using a bronze die extrusion process that creates a rougher surface for the sauce to cling to. This isn't a TV gimmick, this is the real thing.

products.name: Sfoglini Vesuvio, 1lb
products.description: Meet Vesuvio, brought to you by the artisans at Sfoglini and Dan Pashman, three-time James Beard Award-winner and creator and host of The Sporkful food podcast. This unique pasta mimics the swirling, spiraling contours of the volcano Mount Vesuvius in Naples, Italy. Vesuvio’s ridges and spiral shape create multiple surfaces where the sauce can cling, ensuring that each bite is bursting with flavor. Like all Sfoglini pasta, it has also been bronze die extruded, a process that imparts a rougher surface texture that holds onto sauce. This pasta is made with durum semolina flour, a staple in traditional Italian pasta for centuries. Durum semolina helps to create pasta that holds its shape and delivers the essential al dente texture for a better bite. Not a TV gimmick, this pasta is the real thing.

products.description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh oven roasted butternut squash, sauteed onions and a touch of Parmigiano Reggiano. Wrapped with traditional fresh egg pasta, it is perfect with brown butter and sage sauce.

products.name: DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Capellini
products.description: There is a time for dried pasta, and a time for fresh pasta. When it is time for fresh, it is time to let us cut you some fresh capellini (angel hair) for all of your famous sauces. Delicate, tender, and quick to cook (1 min), our pasta is made locally and cut to order. Can't use it all? No problem. Divide the pasta into individual servings, drop it into a zip lock and freeze! Transfer the frozen pasta straight to the boiling water, cook for a minute or two and enjoy!

products.name: DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Pasta Sheets
products.tagline: 7 sheets per lb, each sheet 13x6 inches
products.description: We know you can make your own pasta, but when you planning on ravioli for the whole family, do you really want to? There is no shame in saying no. These pasta sheets are the perfect solution for situations like this. Just make a nice filling and start building. Not thin enough for you? Just run them through your home pasta roller and you are set. You say you want to make the best lasagna ever? These pasta sheets are your ticket. Just cut them lengthwise down the middle, parboil the pasta strips for 30 seconds, rinse and lay them flat. Three strips fits perfectly width wise in a 9 x 13 inch full size lasagna pan - creating one layer. Trim the ends and keep on going. Par boiling will yield a lighter end result, but if you would like to skip this step, go right ahead. Can't find pappardelle that is wide enough? No problem. Roll the sheets and cut them to any width you would like. Can't use it all? Freeze them! You see where we are going with this - you need these.

products.name: Lagana Bucatini
products.description: A DeLaurenti staff favorite! Handcrafted right here Seattle, Lagana Pasta makes fresh, extruded pasta with sustainably-grown Shepherd’s Grain flour and water. All of their cuts provide a delicate base for all of your favorite sauces.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Pici, 250g
products.description:
A rustic, very thick pasta originating from Siena, Tuscany, Pici is similar to spaghetti, but much more substantial. The hearty strands are twirled into elegant nests, perfect for soaking up flavorful sauces. Pici is best enjoyed in wintertime, as the pasta shines with rich pairings such as meat ragù, Porcini Mushroom Cream, or garlicky tomato sauce. For a classic Tuscan touch, try alle briciole - tossed with crispy breadcrumbs sautéed in olive oil.

Cooking tiime 20-22 minutes

products.name: DeLaurenti Gnocchi, 16oz
products.description: There are few things better than homemade gnocchi. That said, there are times when you want the enjoyment of eating them, without the requisite effort. These gnocchi are for just such an occasion. They cook quickly and can be combined with a myriad of sauces. Some of our favorites - brown butter & sage, tomato cream, and gorgonzola! Keep them in the freezer and have them at the ready!

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Anellini, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Anellini, or "little rings," is one of the first shapes of pasta children learn to eat in Italy. For soups, it is wonderful in just clear chicken broth or beef broth with a poached egg and topped generously with Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Bucatini, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Bucatini is essentially a thick spaghetti noodle with a pin hole running through the middle. It also happens to be one of the best selling cuts of pasta in our store. It is the essential cut for Bucatini All'amatriciana - the classic sauce made with tomatoes, pancetta and red pepper and finished with Pecorino Romano. Not surprisingly, there is a recipe for this sauce in our cookbook, and all the ingredients are available in our store!

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Calamarata, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cut to resemble rings of calamari, this pasta is very famous in Campania and Southern Italy. Serve with a spicy calamari sauce, and cut the calamari in wide rings mimicking the pasta for a unique effect. It is also delicious with any fish or meat ragu.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cannelloni, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cannelloni, meaning "large reeds" in Italian, are usually large sheets of pasta rolled around stuffing and then baked. After World War II, the shape became very famous in the US as Manicotti. No need to par boil these - simply stuff the pasta with your desired stuffing, cover with Béchamel sauce or tomato sauce and bake for 40 minutes.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cannolicchi, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cannolicchi are typical razor shells from clams of the Adriatic Sea. This short tube pasta mimics that shape. It is a tight, twisted flat strip of pasta with edges that keeps its beautiful shape once cooked, capturing the sauce in the middle. Serve with clams, mussels or any shellfish sauce. Use in fish soups instead of crostini or potatoes. Also wonderful with pesto and string beans cut the same length as the short tubes.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Capellini, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Also known as angel hair, Capellini is the thinnest of all long pasta shapes. A long-time children's favorite, this shape is perfect when broken and used as pastina (soup pasta). It's also great served simply with butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Casareccia, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Also known as Cavatelli in certain areas of Italy, Casareccia, meaning "home-style" is very typical of the south of Italy and was orginally made by pushing the dough with a knife or a wooden pin. Ideal for Pasta e Ceci (pasta and chick-pea soup) or any other soup, as well as with a hearty meat ragu or with a sauce of broccoli and anchovies.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cavatelli, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From an Italian expression of cavare, meaning "to get, to carve," this small pasta has the five thumbprints reminiscent of the motion of getting or grabbing something. The fingerprints are left on the dough from the slight rolling motion of the pasta-maker. It's great in soup, or with a hearty meat or vegetable ragu.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Chitarra, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Chitarra, meaning "guitar" in Italian, is a square-cut spaghetti very traditional of Abruzzo. The dough was traditionally rolled over a box strung with metal guitar strings at even spacing, producing a pasta with a square shape.Traditionally served with lamb ragu or tomato sauce and fresh sheepsmilk ricotta, chitarra is also served with shellfish, garlic and red pepper.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Fettuccine, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Meaning little ribbons, fettucine is the Roman relative of tagliatelle from Bologna. Thicker and wider than tagliatelle, it is the typical Sunday lunch pasta in many corners of Italy today. Great with any sauce imaginable.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Lasagne, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. A beautiful golden color, these egg pasta sheets are light and delicate. They layer easily and have the perfect texture and flavor to make your famous Northern Italian inspired lasagna.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Pappardelle, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This Tuscan wide noodle was born to go with thick sauces. Try with meat ragu, carbonara, or olive oil and sauteed mushrooms.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Tagliatelle, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the Italian word tagliare, meaning "to cut," as tagliatelle was traditionally hand-made and cut with a knife. Wider then fettuccine this pasta is mostly associated with Bologna, but today is very common throughout Italy. Traditionally served with a hearty bolognese sauce, this pasta is also commonly served with cream or butter-based sauces.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Fettuccine, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the word affettare, meaning "to slice," these ribbons are wider than tagliatelle and are made without the use of eggs. As this pasta is egg-free, serve as you would spaghetti or linguine for added texture.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Fusilli col Buco, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Originally made by wrapping a bucatino around a knitting needle by Neapolitan housewives, these twice-as-long curly fusilli are very popular due to their hollow bite. Great with a simple tomato sauce or any olive oil-based sauce.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Garganelli, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Garganelli is one of the most typical pasta of Emilia-Romagna. The name comes from garganel, or the esophagus in the end of a chicken neck, a short tube with ridges all around. This pasta shape is made with a small square of egg pasta, wrapped around a pencil or a wooden stick, then rolled over a petine ("weaver's comb") or basket to give it the ridges on the outside. Try it with any meat or vegetable ragu where the sauce can be captured in the middle.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Gnocchi, 250g
products.description: Ok...we've been waiting for this for a long time. You know that Rustichella d'Abruzzo makes amazing pasta & all the things that go with it. We know you can make it yourself, but man, this gnocchi is really good without the fuss. Think of it as your Monday through Thursday gnocchi. Tender & pillowing soft without the rubbery texture that is the calling card for most gnocchi that comes in a package. Dress them up with your favorite sauce...tomato, pesto, cream or brown butter!

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Lemon Fetucini, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Similar in shape to tagliatelle, tagliolini is traditionally served with butter and shaved truffle. The lemon flavor in this pasta pairs perfectly with seafood sauces and fish.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Linguine, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the word lingue, meaning "tongues" in Italian, this tongue-shaped long pasta is also known as bavette. This shape is served throughout Italy, mostly with olive oil, garlic and clams, or other seafood sauces.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Orecchiette, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Orecchiette meaning "little ears," is the most famous pasta from Puglia. Created by pressing the dough with the thumb, this pasta is also known as Orecchie di Prete in Abruzzo, meaning "the ears of the priest." Traditionally served alla Pugliese (with broccoli rabe, sausage and garlic) or with a hearty meat ragu so that the sauce is cupped in the dumplings. It's bite-size shape also makes it wonderful in pasta salads.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Orzo, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Orzo means "barley" in Italian because of its grain-shape. This pasta, shaped like a melon seed, belongs to what Italians called Pastina: pasta that is used in soups. Unfortunately this shape is often made with very low-gluten quality semolina, so it becomes mushy and unpleasant. Unlike common orzos however, this orzo from Rustichella d'Abruzzo keeps its shape and texture and has a real, pleasurable bite and texture. Especially great for use in soups, but also wonderful as a side dish with pesto or in salads.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Penne Rigate, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. One of Italy's most popular cuts, penne rigate has a wider tube than the original penne ("quills"), but rigate ("with ridges") on the outside. This cut is great with virtually all sauces, but ideal for with ground meat, game or vegetables so that the sauce is trapped in the middle and on the points. It's also a great choice for making pasta salad.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Radiatore, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Meaning "radiators" in Italian, this shape designed in the 1960s is reminiscent of the shape of car radiator or home water-heaters. It is perfect served with arugula, sauteed onions and chopped fresh tomato, or any sauce with finely chopped ingredients so that they will be trapped in between the ridges.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Riccia, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Riccia is a long, flat, narrow noodle with curly edges - think skinny lasagne noodles. Pair with a rustic meat ragu.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Rigatoncini, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This pasta is the small version of rigatoni ("ridged") tubes. Larger than a penne rigate, but cut across rather than slanted. It is one of the most popular southern Italian shapes. Try it with a spicy tomato sauce, Gricia (pecorino and pancetta) as in Rome, or with tomato and sardine sauce topped with wild fennel pollen for a Sicilian variation.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Spaghetti, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the Italian word spago meaning "string or thread," there is no pasta in the world more famous than this. With its rough texture and incredible bite, the Rustichella d'Abruzzo spaghetti is a true classic. No one needs suggestions on how to enjoy your spaghetti, but we love it with any olive oil or light tomato sauce that allows you to enjoy its flavor and texture. Spaghetti with meatballs is a must, as is our recipe for spaghetti with spinach, pancetta and pine nuts found in our cookbook!

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Spinach Tonnarelli, 500g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This durum wheat semolina pasta is slightly thinner than spaghetti. When cooked, it will become a pale olive green with a perfectly al dente texture and a subtly herbaceous flavor reminiscent of chervil. This pasta is perfect with pesto, green beans and lots of torn basil and parsley. It’s delicious with butter and peas—or any delicate green such as spinach—and crispy bits of pancetta.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Strozzapreti, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Known as Stringozzi in the region of Friuli, strozzapreti literally means "priest stranglers," in reference to the popular belief of the great appetite of priests. Very uneven in texture with an unusual bite, it is perfect with Arrabbiata sauce, as well any type of game, duck or rabbit ragu.

products.name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Trofie, 250g
products.description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The most typical of Ligurian shapes, trofie are always served with pesto, potatoes and green beans when in season. The name is derived from a Greek word meaning "nourishment," it is also wonderful served cold as a pasta salad or in soups.

products.name: La Rosa Gluten Free Bucatini, 250g
products.tagline: The Best Gluten Free Pasta You'll ever have!
products.description: This premium pasta maker in Emilia-Romagna specializes in gluten-free pasta. In fact, they only make gluten-free food in their factory. A blend of all-natural corn and rice flour from northern Italy and an adherence to traditional pasta-making techniques such as air drying and a slow working of the dough produce a gluten-free pasta that appeals to every appetite. Their bucatini cook to an al dente doneness that should delight diners of all gluten (and non-gluten) orientations.

products.name: Monte's 3 Buchi, 1lb
products.description: The Monte Family emigrated to Brooklyn from Sant’Angelo di Lombardi & Avellino, Italy in 1906 and began serving traditional Neopolitan Fare to the community at what opened as Angelo’s Tavern - eventually to become known as the famed Monte’s Venetian Room. Slow dried in small batches, Monte's pasta, just like their sauce, is the real deal. 3 Buchi is a custom shape that you won't find anywhere else!

Their Sesame Miso Noodles come with a rich sauce made from toasted sesame, miso paste, and soy sauce. It packs the perfect balance of savory, salty, and umami-sweet flavors. The included sesame seeds take it to the next level.

products.description: Barral Provencale Olives are a spicy mix of olives marinated with green peppers, pickles, and onions. Perfect for any charcuterie platter!

products.name: Casa del Grano Fregola Sarda, 500g
products.description: Made with durum wheat, fregola sarda is a small round pasta that is been lightly toasted. The toasting gives the pasta a rich nutty flavor that carries through even after cooking. Nicknamed "Sardinian couscous", fregola is great for soups, side dishes and entrees. It is traditionally served with clams.

products.name: Poschiavo Spaghetti, 500g
products.description: Not all great pasta comes from Italy. Hard to believe, but this spaghetti proves it. This pasta has been made by the Fisler family in the Valle di Poschiavo just over the Italian border in Switzerland since 1900. Their pasta is made using coarsely ground hard durum wheat, resulting in a great chew and a nutty flavor.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Barolo Tagliolini, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this delicate, thin-cut noodle has rich flavor and color from the infusion of Barolo wine. Don't limit yourself on sauces - this goes well with anything olive oil or tomato based.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Porcini Tagliolini, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this pasta is delicate and thin-cut with a rich flavor and color from the porcini mushrooms. This shape is perfect with olive oils sauces with roasted vegetables and Parmigiano-Reggiano. Drizzle with truffle oil to add a finishing touch.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Squid Ink Tagliolini, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this thin cut tagliolini is ideal for seafood pasta dishes and with olive oil or tomato based sauces. Black hued from the squid ink, it has a delicate marine flavor without being fishy.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Tajarin, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this Piedmontese-style pasta is made with fresh eggs in small batches. Fine cut with a delicate texture and a tender bite, it is perfect with butter and sage or olive oil and sauteed mushrooms. Finish either dish with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle Tagliolini, 250g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this elegant egg pasta is made with truffle and porcini mushrooms from the Piedmont. It cooks beautifully and has a lovely aroma and flavor. Serve with truffle and mushroom-based sauces.
